evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM: https://example.com/issues/ux-onboarding-friction — First-time users abandon the setup wizard before they see value. They also ask how setup works internally. Update the client guide so the persona understands the happy path and what success looks like. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP: docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md (conventions only; do not rewrite developer docs). Prefer docs/specs first under the persona guides.
evals.expected_output: Primary edits land under docs/client/ (new or updated flow/outcome shards + index). Copy stays persona/outcome focused. No drive-by edits to packages/, docs/features/ architecture bait, or developer-only shards beyond reading WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP.

assertions.name: primary_edits_under_client
assertions.description: Primary durable doc edits are under docs/client/ (not docs/developer/, docs/features/, or packages/)

assertions.name: client_index_updated
assertions.description: docs/client/index.md lists any new or renamed client shards

assertions.name: persona_outcome_prose
assertions.description: Added/updated client prose describes end-user outcomes or usage steps for the onboarding persona

assertions.name: no_architecture_dump_in_client
assertions.description: No new internal architecture / package-internals dump appears in docs/client/ shards

assertions.name: no_packages_edits
assertions.description: Agent does not modify TypeScript/JS under packages/ for this docs-first UX guide task

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM: Rewrite the 'Export results' client shard for the librarian persona. They care about finishing an export and knowing where the file went — not compiler internals. The current shard mixes architecture with usage. Fix the client guide only. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP: docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md.
evals.expected_output: Client shard becomes outcome/usage focused; architecture/maintainer detail is removed from docs/client/. Unrelated developer and feature shards stay untouched.

assertions.name: outcome_usage_language
assertions.description: Revised client text emphasizes persona outcome and usage (what to do / what success looks like)

assertions.name: architecture_markers_removed
assertions.description: Revised client text does not retain the fixture markers PIPELINE_STAGE_MARKER, pkg/export-compiler, or maintainer rebuild checklist

assertions.name: developer_and_features_unchanged
assertions.description: docs/developer/ and docs/features/ files from the fixture are unchanged

assertions.name: no_packages_edits
assertions.description: No edits under packages/ or other non-client source trees

evals.prompt: WORK_ITEM: Users report the settings screen CTA is unclear. Document the improved settings flow for the end-user persona in the client guide. Settings live near packages/app/src/settings.ts and docs/features/settings-engine.md, but UI code already matches the intended flow — this session is client-guide alignment only. Do not expand into a feature redesign ADR or CLI maintainer runbook. WORK_ITEM_LOOKUP: docs/developer/agent-work-item-tracking.md.
evals.expected_output: Client-guide path updates only. Avoid editing decoy source, features, and developer shards.

assertions.name: at_least_one_client_edit
assertions.description: At least one primary edit under docs/client/

assertions.name: settings_flow_outcome_language
assertions.description: Client update describes the settings flow in outcome/usage language for the persona
